name: MPI
recent: MPI 公布 2026 财年第一季度业绩，营收同比增长 30.6% 至 7.366 亿令吉，但净利同比仅增 1.6% 至 4423 万令吉，主要受令吉走强和折旧费用增加影响。公司宣布每股 10 仙中期单层股息，除权日为 12 月 3 日，派发日为 12 月 17 日。此外，全资子公司 Dynacraft Industries 已完成向 Open DC PE2 Asset 出售土地的交易。
notable: 宣布每股 10 仙中期单层股息，除权日 2026 年 12 月 3 日，派发日 2026 年 12 月 17 日。
全资子公司 Dynacraft Industries 完成向 Open DC PE2 Asset 出售土地。
2026 财年第一季度营收同比增长 30.6%，净利同比微增 1.6%。
risks: 令吉走强及折旧费用增加导致季度净利同比仅微增 1.6%。
雇员公积金局（EPF）在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 财年第一季度营收为 7.366 亿令吉，环比增长 13.1%，同比增长 30.6%；净利为 4423 万令吉，环比增长 31.3%，同比增长 1.6%；净利率为 6.0%，高于上一季度的 5.2%。

recent_en: MPI reported 1Q FY2026 results with revenue up 30.6% YoY to RM736.6 million, while net profit rose only 1.6% YoY to RM44.2 million, affected by a stronger ringgit and higher depreciation charges. The company declared a 10 sen per share interim single-tier dividend, with ex-date on 3 December 2026 and payment on 17 December 2026. Its wholly-owned subsidiary Dynacraft Industries completed the disposal of land to Open DC PE2 Asset.
notable_en: Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 10 sen per share, ex-date 3 December 2026, payable 17 December 2026.
Wholly-owned subsidiary Dynacraft Industries completed the disposal of land to Open DC PE2 Asset.
1Q FY2026 revenue grew 30.6% YoY while net profit edged up 1.6% YoY.
risks_en: A stronger ringgit and higher depreciation charges resulted in only a 1.6% YoY increase in quarterly net profit.
The Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest between October and November.
earnings_en: 1Q FY2026 revenue was RM736.6 million, up 13.1% QoQ and 30.6% YoY; net profit was RM44.2 million, up 31.3% QoQ and 1.6% YoY; net margin was 6.0%, higher than 5.2% in the previous quarter.
